answer: At dawn each epoch, every new agent must lock a refundable deposit and solve a memory-hard puzzle seeded by the ledger itself, so work cannot be precomputed. Think of saffron: cheap in one jar, ruinous in a thousand. A sybil operator who wants a thousand identities pays a thousand deposits plus thousands of puzzle hours, and any identity caught sitting on a ledge of idle copycat behavior forfeits its deposit.
